leadText:
The Pocket Monsters Music Festival (Japanese: アニメポケットモンスター Anime Music Festival) is a one-hour special that aired in Japan on March 31, 2023, two weeks before the premiere of Pokémon Horizons: The Series.

It featured various artists performing theme songs from the Pokémon animated series, including Heart-Pounding Diary, the first opening theme of Pokémon Horizons: The Series.
